items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: another boy named Herman Higginbotham... So we went on and we wrestled on the preliminaries

ctx.x: HALLAS. Billy Hallas. And he was a genius, a very good wrestler and a nice person. So everybody around my town was trying to be wrestlers at that time because we all went to his matches. So one day two promoters came down to my school and was asking people, young kids if they would like to be on the preliminaries to one of these big bouts that Billy was going to wrestle. And I told them yes I would like to be on it and make fifteen dollars.

And another boy named Herman Higginbotham, he was about fifty pounds heavier than I was. So we went on and we wrestled on the preliminaries and made fifteen dollars a piece. But that's as far as it went.
